title: The Welcome
source_seed: The mother of the devoted: She receives the one who calls
caption_hook: She opens her arms to the ones who call. Come across.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, three-quarter-length framing from the reference portrait. The camera pulls back slightly so Her open arms stay fully in frame, with the crown and golden sun disc centered and fully framed.
shots.action: She opens both arms slowly outward from Her sides, palms open toward the viewer in a wide gesture of protection, and the golden sun disc and the bright star above Her crown brighten as Her stern gaze softens into a faint, tender smile. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: Big, readable body motion unlike a walk: protection offered, with the sun and star answering.
